title: SOE Estimator (Adaptive Kalman Filter)
text: State of energy and terminal resistance estimator with adaptive Kalman filter, 5 inputs, 1 output, {Filter type} sets Kalman; {Specify Current input as cell current(s)} sets the option, {Alpha}, {Beta}, {Kappa}, {Covariance of the process noise, Q} sets the covariance of the process noise, {Covariance of the measurement noise, R}, {Initial state error covariance, P0} sets the initial state error covariance, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample, {Charge dynamics} sets the option, {Vector of state-of-energy values, SOE (-)} sets the sOE breakpoints, {Vector of temperatures, T} sets the temperature, {First polarization resistance, R1(SOE,T), (ohm)} sets the first RC resistance at temperature breakpoints, {First time constant, tau1(SOE,T), (s)} sets the first RC time constant at temperature breakpoints, {Second polarization resistance, R2(SOE,T), (ohm)} sets the second RC resistance at temperature breakpoints, {Second time constant, tau2(SOE,T), (s)} sets the second RC time constant at temperature breakpoints, {No-load voltage, V0(SOE,T), (V)} sets the v 0 lookup table 3.55, 3.57, 3.56; 3.62, 3.63, 3.64; 3.71, 3.71, 3.72; 3.91, 3.93, 3.94; {Nominal cell energy capacity, Enom, (W*Hr)} sets the cell energy capacity of battery when fully and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.
